Patient ID: PT-000001
Demographics: 62-year-old male presenting for Cycle 4 evaluation.

DIAGNOSIS & MOLECULAR PROFILING:
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV Breast Cancer.
Genomic Profile: Confirmed driver mutation in KRAS. Secondary mutation: None/Unknown.
Tumor mutational burden measured at 0.4 mut/Mb with ctDNA level of 0.76 ng/mL.

Patient currently demonstrates no acute adverse toxicities. Physical examination reveals no jaundice, no acute respiratory distress, and clear lung fields bilaterally.

TREATMENT PLAN & REGIMEN:
Administer scheduled therapy with Docetaxel at a dosage of 265.4 mg.
Pre-medications ordered per protocol. Serial monitoring of renal markers and complete blood count scheduled prior to next infusion.
